shortDescription: Configures a workload group for use by the Resource Governor

options.name: group_max_requests
options.description: Specifies the maximum number of simultaneous requests that are allowed to execute in the workload group.

options.name: importance
options.description: Specifies the relative importance of a request in the workload group.

options.name: max_dop
options.description: Specifies the maximum degree of parallelism (MAXDOP) for parallel query execution.

options.name: request_max_cpu_time
options.description: Specifies the maximum amount of CPU time, in seconds, that a request can use.

options.name: request_max_mem_grant_perc
options.description: Specifies the maximum amount of memory that a single request can take from the pool.

options.name: request_mem_grant_timeout_sec
options.description: Specifies the maximum time, in seconds, that a query can wait for a memory grant (work buffer memory) to become available.

options.name: resource_pool
options.description: Name of the resource pool for the workload group.

options.name: resource_pool_type
options.description: Specify the type of resource pool.

options.name: sql_instance
options.description: The SQL Server instance to modify.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether or not the object should be C(present) or C(absent).

options.name: workload_group
options.description: Name of the target workload group.
